name: Withdrawal button
description: The online withdrawal function for distance contracts (EU Directive 2023/2673; in Bulgaria ЗЗП чл. 52а, in force from 24.09.2026): a "Withdraw from contract here" link, a two-step statement for guests and customers, an email confirmation with date and time, and a list for staff.

permissions.label: See and handle withdrawals from contracts

settings.label: Withdrawal period (days)
settings.help: 14 days in the EU, counted from delivery. Used to mark statements that look late; every statement is accepted and confirmed.

settings.label: Send statements to
settings.help: Staff address for new statements. Empty: the staff notification address, or the store's contact email.

author: PN Scripts
